{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check unique channels
unique_channels = df['channel'].unique()
print(f'Unique channels: {unique_channels}')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
num_qa = qa_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of QA orders: {num_qa}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
num_refunded = refunded_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded}')

# Check data type of revenue
print(f'Data type of revenue: {df["revenue"].dtype}')

# Inspect the first few revenue values
df['revenue'].head(10)"}
